text: More often ask yourself: “What do I want right now? What kind of pleasure exactly?” Not “What else must I manage to do today?”, and not even “How to spend this evening?”, but precisely “What does my body want for pleasure?”. Do I want to drink tea? Do I want to yawn and stretch? Do I want to relax my forehead and stroke my face with my palms? At the level of the second chakra desires are very simple. Become aware of them and satisfy them. Well, and what is “difficult”—in this case is “false.” Direct attention to these simple bodily desires. By acknowledging and satisfying them, you train your ability to be on the “wave of wanting” :)
